items.title: The Beef Shawarma Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Our prime cut marinated USDA beef tenderloin topped with onions, tomatoes, pickled turnips, and tahini sauce wrapped in our famous toasted #Samistyle pita

items.title: The Chicken Shawarma Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Our marinated all white meat chicken breast grilled to perfection. Finished with Lebanese pickles and house-made garlic toum in our signature crispy #SamiStyle Pita.

items.title: The Falafel Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Scratch-made falafel, crisp outside and herb-bright inside. Finished with lettuce, tomatoes, sport peppers, Lebanese pickles, turnips, and smooth tahini — wrapped in our signature crispy #SamiStyle Pita.

items.title: The Beirut Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Our marinated all white meat chicken breast, grilled to perfection, topped with tomatoes, shredded cabbage, Lebanese Pickles, and crispy fries, drizzled with our signature garlic sauce wrapped in our famous crispy #Samistyle pita

items.title: The Chicken Fattoush Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Our marinated all white meat chicken breast grilled to perfection, topped with our award-winning Fattoush salad, Lebanese pickles and drizzled with our signature garlic sauce, wrapped in our famous crispy #Samistyle pita.

items.title: The Sujok Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: A Dearborn twist to a Bourj Hamoud favorite. Richly spiced Lebanese sujuk sausage, seared and layered to perfection topped with lettuce, tomato, Lebanese pickles, a little mayo action, drizzled with our signature garlic sauce with a hint of fresh squeezed lemon — served in our golden-crispy #SamiStyle Pita.

items.title: The Batata Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Our crispy seasoned coated fries, topped with shredded cabbage, Lebanese pickles, drizzled with sweet cedar sauce, wrapped in our famous toasted #SamiStyle pita.

items.title: The Amo Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Hold up! Wait a minute! Amo Sami threw TAWOOK up in it! Topped with Lebanese Pickles, house made coleslaw, crispy seasoned coated fries, and drizzled with our signature garlic sauce and sweet ketchup, wrapped in our world-famous toasted #SamiStyle pita.

items.title: The OOPSIE! Vegan Beef Shawarma Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: OOPSIE, we did it again, made you think it was beef! Our slow marinated savory plant-based beef grilled to perfection and layered with onions, tomatoes, pickled turnips, and tahini — wrapped in our golden, crispy #SamiStyle Pita.

items.title: The Scoot Over Cheek'n Shawarma Sami
items.ingredients_or_description: Our slow marinated Plant-based Cheek’n breast with Lebanese pickles and house garlic sauce, finished in our signature crispy #SamiStyle Pita. You might just think you're cheating with real chicken!

items.title: Sami's Fattoush Salad
items.ingredients_or_description: Our award - winning blend of fresh romaine lettuce, tomato, cucumber, red onion, shredded cabbage, freshly baked Sami-Style pita chips in our famous house dressing. Add protein to your salad for an upcharge.

items.ingredients_or_description: Breadless bowls packed with your choice of protein.
